value.name: Sonoma Clean Power
value.notes: Sonoma Clean Power is the public power provider for Sonoma and Mendocino counties, serving all incorporated cities in Sonoma County except Healdsburg (its own municipal utility) and Ukiah (Mendocino County). PG&E continues to deliver the power and provide billing/customer service. This membership fact is based on Sonoma Clean Power's own public description rather than a directly fetched member-list page (sonomacleanpower.org's dedicated service-area page returned HTTP 404 this session).
